description: Source code for lua's precompiled chunk dumping functionality, including functions for serializing Lua prototypes, constants, upvalues, debug info, and writing the dump header.

methods.name: dumpBlock
methods.description: Serializes a block of memory to the dump output, handling endianness and size.

methods.name: dumpSize
methods.description: Encodes a size_t value into a variable-length format for serialization.

methods.name: dumpString
methods.description: Serializes a TString, including its length and content.

methods.name: dumpCode
methods.description: Serializes the bytecode of a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: dumpFunction
methods.description: Serializes a Lua function prototype, including source, code, constants, upvalues, nested functions, and debug info.

methods.name: dumpConstants
methods.description: Serializes the constants used in a Lua function.

methods.name: dumpUpvalues
methods.description: Serializes upvalue information for a function.

methods.name: dumpDebug
methods.description: Serializes debug information such as line info, local variables, and upvalue names.

methods.name: dumpHeader
methods.description: Serializes the header for a precompiled Lua chunk.

methods.name: luaU_dump
methods.description: Main function to serialize a Lua function prototype into a precompiled chunk, including header and function data.
